q: Which one is non-polarized capacitors? (2024)
e: Film capacitors are non-polarized capacitors.

q: A _________ is an electrical device that stores electrical energy in the form of an electric field. (2026)
e: A capacitor is an electrical device that stores electrical energy in an electric field.

q: By what percentage does the capacitance change when the distance between the two parallel plates of a capacitor is doubled? (2024)
e: Capacitance is inversely proportional to plate separation distance, so doubling the distance decreases capacitance by 50%.

q: What does changing the charge on a capacitor primarily affect? (2026)
e: Since V = Q/C, changing the charge on a capacitor primarily affects the voltage across it.

q: Insulating materials have the dielectric constant values of _________. (2026)
e: Insulating materials always have dielectric constant values greater than one.

q: The equivalent capacitance _________ when the individual capacitors are connected in series. (2026)
e: Connecting capacitors in series decreases the overall equivalent capacitance.

q: Which capacitor is used as a tuning capacitor? (2024)
e: Variable capacitors are specifically used as tuning capacitors in radio circuits.

q: Two conductors of capacitor of capacitance C are brought together to a third of their original separation. What is its capacitance now? (2026)
e: Capacitance is inversely proportional to separation distance; reducing separation to one-third triples the capacitance.

q: The capacitors are connected in series each capacitor has the same _________. (2026)
e: When capacitors are connected in series, each stores the exact same electric charge.

q: A capacitor consists of two _________ separated by a small distance. (2026)
e: A basic capacitor consists of two conductors separated by a small distance or insulating material.

q: _________ use ceramic as the dielectric material. (2026)
e: Ceramic capacitors utilize ceramic material as their dielectric layer.

q: When the distance between the two parallel plates of a capacitor is doubled, by what percent does its capacitance change? (2025)
e: Doubling plate separation halves the capacitance, resulting in a 50% decrease.

q: The dielectric constant κ of insulating materials is _________. (2025)
e: Dielectric constants for insulating materials are strictly greater than 1.

q: Which type of energy does the capacitor store? (2025)
e: Capacitors store electrical energy in the form of electric potential energy.

q: When the capacitors are connected in series, each capacitor has the same _________. (2025)
e: Capacitors in series share the exact same amount of stored charge.

q: What happens to the capacitance of a variable capacitor when the distance between the plates in increased? (2025)
e: Increasing plate distance decreases the capacitance.

q: The dielectric constant κ of insulating materials is _________. (2025)
e: The dielectric constant for insulating materials is greater than 1.

q: How does the capacitance of a capacitor vary when the charge on the capacitor is increased? (2025)
e: Capacitance depends on physical dimensions and dielectric material, so increasing charge leaves capacitance constant.

q: The capacitance of a parallel plate capacitor increases when: (2025)
a: The distance between the plates increases
The area of the plates increases
e: Capacitance is directly proportional to the area of the conducting plates.

q: In a combination of capacitors, the total capacitance is less than the smallest individual capacitance in: (2025)
e: In a series combination, total capacitance is always less than the smallest individual capacitance.

q: Film capacitors and ceramic capacitors are _________ capacitors. (2025)
e: Both film and ceramic capacitors belong to the non-polarized capacitor category.

q: Variable capacitors mostly use _________ as the dielectric medium. (2025)
e: Air is commonly used as the dielectric medium in variable capacitors.

q: Which of the following capacitors are polarized capacitor? (2025)
e: Electrolytic capacitors are polarized components with specific positive and negative terminals.

q: What is the time constant τ of a capacitor charging or discharging process? (2025)
a: the product of the resistance and the capacitance
the sum of the resistance and the capacitance
the ration of the resistance to the capacitance
e: The time constant is equal to the product of resistance R and capacitance C.

q: What capacitor is used as a tuning capacitor? (2025)
e: Variable capacitors serve as tuning capacitors in radio communication systems.

q: Which capacitors are the ones that use the oxide layer as the dielectric material? (2025)
e: Electrolytic capacitors use a thin oxide layer formed on metal as their dielectric.

e: Doubling plate spacing reduces capacitance to half its value, which is a 50% decrease.

q: _________ can also be used in a time-dependent circuit (timer circuit). (2025)

e: Ceramic capacitors are non-polarized.

q: _________ can also be used in a time-dependent circuit (timer circuit). (2026)
e: Capacitors store energy and discharge predictably, making them suitable for timer circuits.

q: The value of dielectric constant of vacuum is _________. (2026)
e: The dielectric constant of a vacuum is defined as exactly 1.

e: The product of resistance and capacitance gives the RC time constant.
